statement: Count active individual members as one client-backed MATCHED_INDIVIDUAL row from the latest complete official EZFacility Memberships By Status projection. Include PIF; exclude business classes and additional active memberships for the same client. Do not substitute churned_at IS NULL.

Report the actual source report date and fetch timestamp per location. Missing, incomplete, or unreconciled projections produce unknown/partial counts, never fabricated zero counts. Label stale data using observed timestamps.
Gym NYC is a partner, not the founder's gym; equity ownership is unconfirmed.
The Gym NYC operations fee is founder-reported and conditional on dashboard completion and buyer acceptance. Activation and collections are unverified; do not describe it as collected revenue.
Controlled alpha scope is not proof of enrollment, usage, deployment, or certification. Enrollment is unknown, not zero; do not invent usage evidence.
Milo is the operating system for athletic life. Organization agents for athletics operators are being built; do not describe unshipped agents as live.
